ingestion_flows.source_description: FlowX test TC-PRM-004: batch Auto Loader transaction feed testing whether ${param} placeholders are substituted inside a dq_config rule expression. GAP CONFIRMED (this build pass): grepping onboarding/spec_validator.py, transformation/parameters.py, dq/quarantine.py and dq/expectations.py shows substitute_dynamic_parameters/substitute_path_parameters are only ever called against transformation_sql, reconciliation filter_condition/transform_sql, and source_config/target_config *path* fields -- never against dq_config.rules[].expression. docs/17_onboarding_template_reference.md itself confirms this in prose ('Not wired into dq_config'). So this spec's dq_config.rules[].expression below intentionally uses the LITERAL values (50000 / '2026-01-01') copied from pipeline_parameters above, instead of the ${max_allowed_txn_limit}/${cutoff_date} placeholders TESTING_PLAN.md's TC-PRM-004 describes -- writing the placeholders here would either pass through as literal, un-substituted text into the compiled Lakeflow expectation (SparkSQL parse failure on '${...}') or silently never quarantine anything, depending on how the literal string parses. pipeline_parameters is still declared, matching TESTING_PLAN.md's spec shape and kept for documentation/structural fidelity, but is otherwise unused by this ingestion-only spec (no transformation_flows/reconciliation_flows to consume it either). See docs/68_tc_prm_004.md for the full writeup.
